scope: Only crop/contain transform and native exterior labels; no data point resampling or rewriting
basis: Original full-size image opened with view_image. Dark neutral pixel column/row runs identify drawn axes; top/right tick endpoint centers checked independently. Line stroke thickness gives roughly ±1 source-pixel uncertainty.
mapping: Image contain scale=min(slot.w/crop.w,slot.h/crop.h), centered in slot. Native x(v)=image.x+(x6000+(v−6000)/4000*(x10000−x6000)−crop.x)*scale. Native y(v)=image.y+(y6000−(v−6000)/4000*(y6000−y10000)−crop.y)*scale. Tick text centers align to mapped positions.
validation: Top, midpoint, bottom and units compared to original image; actual final render still reviewed.
